signature.name: VTask.finLiftOn
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> [DecidableEq ι] -> [Fintype ι] -> {α : ι → Sort u_2} -> {β : Sort u_3} -> (q : (i : ι) → Trunc (α i)) -> (f : ((i : ι) → α i) → β) -> (h : ∀ (a b : (i : ι) → α i), f a = f b) -> β

conventions.statement: When ι is an empty type (IsEmpty ι), the result equals f applied to the canonical absurd/empty section, regardless of the value of q.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {α : ι → Sort*} {β : Sort*} (a : ∀ i, α i) (f : (∀ i, α i) → β) (h : ∀ a b : ∀ i, α i, f a = f b), VTask.finLiftOn (fun i => Trunc.mk (a i)) f h = f a

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [e : IsEmpty ι] {α : ι → Sort*} {β : Sort*} (q : ∀ i, Trunc (α i)) (f : (∀ i, α i) → β) (h : ∀ a b : ∀ i, α i, f a = f b), VTask.finLiftOn q f h = f e.elim

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {α : ι → Sort*} {β : Sort*} (q : ∀ i, Trunc (α i)) (c : β), VTask.finLiftOn q (fun _ => c) (fun a b => rfl) = c

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {α : ι → Sort*} {β : Sort*} (q1 q2 : ∀ i, Trunc (α i)) (f : (∀ i, α i) → β) (h : ∀ a b : ∀ i, α i, f a = f b), VTask.finLiftOn q1 f h = VTask.finLiftOn q2 f h

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {α : ι → Sort*} (q : ∀ i, Trunc (α i)) (P : (∀ i, α i) → Prop) (h : ∀ a b : ∀ i, α i, P a = P b), VTask.finLiftOn q P h = True ∨ VTask.finLiftOn q P h = False
